day.intent: Safer routine window for gathering, crafting, fishing, farming, cooking, processing, and trade prep.

nightfall.intent: Danger window for prepared combat players. Monsters are tougher, hit harder, and reward more combat EXP.

notes: PvE death should matter after onboarding.
PvP death must not become a grief tool.
Tune recovery time, not just percentage.

classAwakening.fantasyTarget: Five times more fun and impactful, not a locked 5x raw damage multiplier.

pvpLevelScaling.principle: Level matters strongly. Extreme level gaps can produce one-shot outcomes in valid PvP.

levelGapBrackets.intent: lower level is in serious danger
lower level can be burst down quickly
lower level can be one-shot in valid PvP

antiGriefBoundary: starter zones can restrict hostile actions
repeated killing can trigger corruption or bounty
pvp death uses separate rules from pve death
valid pvp risk should not mean spawn-camp abuse

pkConsequence.redNameUiRule: nameplate or name text turns red so the player is clearly marked as hostile

guardResponse.result: one-shot kill against red name players

structuredWarModes.purpose: primary PvP areas with their own gear-risk rules
structuredWarModes.gearRisk: multiplayer kills, deaths, or war participation can cost gear or durability according to explicit war rules
structuredWarModes.redNameRelationship: red name handles uncontrolled open-world PK; structured war has separate visible risk terms

boosters.copyRule: Explain duration, scope, cap, and reduced stacking value in plain language before purchase.

pets.paidBoundary: Convenience and style only. No direct combat power and no uncapped rare-drop control.

bear.function: Earnable presence or defensive fantasy without paid combat dominance.

hawk.function: Earnable scouting fantasy without paid combat dominance.

storageRunner.purpose: Send one item or small bundle to storage without fast travel.
storageRunner.mustNot: Move unlimited cargo or teleport the player.

marketRunner.purpose: Buy, list, or retrieve one marketplace item from the field.
marketRunner.mustNot: Enable unlimited remote trading or market dominance.
